name: Derental (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of green, yellow and red, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Derental (a yellow lion pierced by a spear on green).
history: Municipal flag of Derental; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Derental arms — lion with spear on green
